name: Delhi Free DTC Bus Travel Scheme (Pink Passes)
description: Promotes safety, mobility, and economic participation of women by providing 100% free public bus transportation in the National Capital Territory.
beneficiary_type: All Female Commuters in Delhi NCT
benefits: Free daily travel in all Delhi Transport Corporation (DTC) and cluster (DIMTS) AC and Non-AC city buses using Single Journey Pink Passes.
eligibility_text: All female passengers of all age groups travelling on DTC or Cluster buses in Delhi NCT.
documents_required: No documentation needed during commute.
application_process: No prior registration required. Request a free 'Pink Ticket' from bus conductor upon boarding.

name: Gaura Devi Kanya Dhan Yojana (Uttarakhand)
description: Incentivizes female education and reduces early marriage in hill and rural regions of Uttarakhand.
department: Department of Women and Child Development Uttarakhand
beneficiary_type: 12th Pass Girl Students from SC, ST, and BPL Families
benefits: One-time fixed deposit grant of Rs 51,000 upon passing Class 12 from recognized state boards.
eligibility_text: Resident girl student of Uttarakhand from SC, ST, or BPL general household who passed Class 12 exam from recognized board in Uttarakhand.
documents_required: Class 12 Passing Certificate / Marksheet, Uttarakhand Domicile, BPL / Caste Certificate, Bank Account Details.
application_process: Apply online through the Uttarakhand Social Welfare Portal (esw.uk.gov.in) with school verification.

name: Griha Aadhar Scheme (Goa)
description: Financial assistance program in Goa to help housewives and homemakers maintain family nutritional security and offset inflation.
department: Directorate of Women and Child Development Goa
beneficiary_type: Homemakers and Housewives in Goa
benefits: Monthly financial disbursement of Rs 1,500 credited directly into the housewife's bank account.
eligibility_text: Married woman residing in Goa for at least 15 years. Annual gross income of husband and wife together should not exceed Rs 3,00,000.
documents_required: 15-year Goa Residence Certificate, Marriage Certificate, Aadhaar Card, Family Income Certificate, Bank Passbook.
application_process: Submit physical form at Goa Citizen Service Centers (Grahak Seva Kendras) or Directorate of Women and Child Development, Panaji.

name: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme
description: A universal basic income initiative for women heads of households in Karnataka to promote financial independence and dignity.
department: Department of Women and Child Development Karnataka
beneficiary_type: Female Heads of Households in Karnataka
benefits: Monthly financial aid of Rs 2,000 credited directly to the woman head of the family's bank account.
eligibility_text: Woman designated as the head of the family in Antyodaya, BPL, or APL ration cards in Karnataka. Neither the applicant nor her husband should be an income tax or GST payer.
documents_required: Ration Card (APL/BPL/AAY), Aadhaar Card of woman and husband, Bank Account Passbook linked with Aadhaar.
application_process: Register at Karnataka One, Grama One, Bapuji Seva Kendra, or through the Seva Sindhu online portal.

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
description: Non-contributory pension scheme under NSAP ensuring monthly social security financial assistance to poor widows across India.
beneficiary_type: Widows from BPL households
benefits: Monthly direct bank transfer pension of Rs 300 (central component) plus matching state top-up (often reaching Rs 1,000 to Rs 2,500/month depending on state).
eligibility_text: Widow aged between 40 and 79 years living below the poverty line (BPL) as verified by local authorities or SECC lists.
documents_required: Husband's Death Certificate, Aadhaar Card, BPL Ration Card, Bank Passbook, Age Verification Proof.
application_process: Apply through the local Gram Panchayat office, Block Development Office (BDO), or online on the NSAP Portal (nsap.nic.in).

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
description: Widow aged between 40 and 79 years who belongs to a household below the poverty line (BPL) as per central guidelines.
beneficiary_type: Widows aged 40-79 years belonging to BPL households
benefits: Monthly pension of Rs 300 to Rs 1,000 (with state contribution top-up) directly disbursed to beneficiary bank accounts.
eligibility_text: Widow aged between 40 and 79 years who belongs to a household below the poverty line (BPL) as per central guidelines.
documents_required: Death Certificate of Husband, BPL Ration Card, Aadhaar Card, Bank Account Details, Age Proof
application_process: Apply online at https://nsap.nic.in/.

name: Kanya Sumangala / Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah Yojana (Chhattisgarh)
description: Assists poor families with marriage expenses of their adult daughters and promotes mass weddings to reduce social financial burden.
department: Department of Women and Child Development CG
beneficiary_type: Daughters of Low-Income Families in Chhattisgarh
benefits: Financial assistance of Rs 50,000 per girl child (Rs 20,000 directly to bride's bank account, gift items, and wedding ceremony expenditure).
eligibility_text: Resident of Chhattisgarh. Girl must be aged 18+ and groom aged 21+. Family must hold BPL card or Antyodaya card. Maximum two daughters per family.
documents_required: Age Proof of Bride and Groom, BPL Ration Card, Chhattisgarh Domicile Certificate, Bank Passbook of Bride.
application_process: Apply at District Women & Child Development Office or Block Project Officer office 30 days before scheduled mass marriage.

name: Kanyashree Prakalpa
description: UN Public Service Award-winning scheme in West Bengal to improve the status of adolescent girls, incentivize schooling, and prevent child marriage.
department: Department of Women & Child Development and Social Welfare WB
beneficiary_type: Adolescent Girls and Students in West Bengal
benefits: Annual scholarship K1 of Rs 1,000 for girls aged 13-18 enrolled in classes 8-12; One-time grant K2 of Rs 25,000 upon turning 18 if unmarried and pursuing education.
eligibility_text: Unmarried girls aged 13-19 years residing in West Bengal and studying in recognized school/college/vocational institution. Annual family income under Rs 1,20,000 (waived for orphans/disabled).
documents_required: Age Proof Certificate (Birth Certificate/Admit Card), Unmarried Declaration, School Enrolment Certificate, Income Certificate, Bank Passbook.
application_process: Collect and submit application form directly at the school or institution where the student is enrolled.

name: Kudumbashree Women Empowerment & Livelihood Mission
description: State Poverty Eradication Mission in Kerala operating community-based women's self-help groups for micro-enterprises and poverty alleviation.
beneficiary_type: Women in Kerala, Neighborhood Groups (NHG)
benefits: Access to subsidized micro-credit loans, skill training, enterprise incubation grants, collective farming land access, and state marketing linkages.
eligibility_text: Women residents of Kerala organized into local neighborhood groups (NHG) and Community Development Societies (CDS).
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Ration Card, Local Resident Certificate, NHG Membership Details.
application_process: Join nearest local Ward Neighborhood Group (Ayalkootam) or register at Grama Panchayat Kudumbashree CDS office.

name: Mahalakshmi Scheme (Free Bus Travel & LPG Subsidy)
description: Guarantee scheme offering 100% free bus travel in state TSRTC buses, financial support, and subsidized LPG cylinders for women.
department: Transport and Civil Supplies Department Telangana
beneficiary_type: All Girls, Women, and Transgender Persons in Telangana
benefits: Zero-fare travel across Telangana in Palle Velugu and Express RTC buses, Rs 2,500 monthly financial assistance to poor women, and LPG cylinder at Rs 500.
eligibility_text: All domicile women, girls, and transgender persons of Telangana. Domicile identity proof required during bus commute.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Telangana Food Security / White Ration Card, Bank Account Details.
application_process: Show valid domicile photo identity proof (Aadhaar, Voter ID, Ration Card) to bus conductor for zero-fare ticket; apply for welfare assistance via Praja Palana application.

name: Mahila Samman Savings Certificate (MSSC)
description: Government-guaranteed short-term savings certificate designed exclusively for women and girls offering attractive fixed returns.
beneficiary_type: Women and Girls
benefits: 7.5% fixed interest rate compounded quarterly. Deposit limits from Rs 1,000 up to Rs 2 Lakh for a 2-year tenor. Partial withdrawal of up to 40% allowed after 1 year.
eligibility_text: Any resident Indian woman or girl (account can be opened by guardian in case of minor girl). No upper age limit or income ceiling.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Account opening KYC form, Passport size photos.
application_process: Visit any designated Department of Posts (Post Office) branch or participating public/private commercial bank branch.

name: Mahila Samman Savings Certificate (MSSC)
description: One-time small savings scheme for women and girls offering guaranteed 7.5% fixed interest per annum for a 2-year tenor.
ministry: Department of Posts / Ministry of Finance
beneficiary_type: Women & Girls
benefits: 7.5% fixed interest rate compounded quarterly. Deposit up to Rs 2 Lakhs. Partial withdrawal up to 40% allowed after 1 year.
eligibility_text: One-time small savings scheme for women and girls offering guaranteed 7.5% fixed interest per annum for a 2-year tenor.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, KYC Form, Passport size photo
application_process: Submit application via official portal: https://www.indiapost.gov.in/

name: Maiya Samman Yojana (Jharkhand)
description: Financial security scheme for women in Jharkhand to support daily living, health, and economic self-sufficiency.
department: Department of Women, Child Development and Social Security Jharkhand
beneficiary_type: Women aged 18 to 50 years in Jharkhand
benefits: Monthly financial grant of Rs 1,000 (Rs 12,000 per annum) directly credited to Aadhaar-linked bank accounts.
eligibility_text: Women residing in Jharkhand aged between 18 and 50 years with family income below poverty line. Excludes government service employees or income tax payers.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Jharkhand Ration Card (Yellow/Pink), Bank Account Details, Self-declaration.
application_process: Apply at special camps organized at Gram Panchayat and Ward levels or online at the official Jharkhand portal.

name: Mission Shakti - Odisha
description: Statewide program in Odisha transforming women's Self Help Groups into vibrant micro-enterprises through interest-free bank loans and government procurement quotas.
beneficiary_type: Self Help Group (SHG) Women in Odisha
benefits: Interest-free business loans up to Rs 5 Lakh (0% interest subvention), Revolving Fund and Mission Shakti scooter subsidies for community leaders.
eligibility_text: Active women members of registered SHGs in rural and urban areas of Odisha.
documents_required: SHG Registration Certificate, Member Aadhaar Cards, SHG Bank Account Passbook, Resolution Copy.
application_process: Apply through Block Level Federation (BLF) / Gram Panchayat Level Federation (GPLF) and Mission Shakti portal.

name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme (Pudhumai Penn)
description: Flagship scheme in Tamil Nadu to increase female enrollment in higher education by providing monthly stipends directly into bank accounts.
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department TN
beneficiary_type: Female Students from Government Schools
benefits: Monthly financial aid of Rs 1,000 transferred directly until the student completes undergraduate degree, diploma, or ITI course.
eligibility_text: Female students who studied in Tamil Nadu Government schools from Class 6 to 12 and enrolled in an accredited higher education degree/diploma program.
documents_required: Transfer Certificate / Class 6-12 Govt School Certificate, Aadhaar Card, College Admission Card, Student Bank Account Details.
application_process: Register through college nodal officers on the Penkalvi Tamil Nadu web portal (penkalvi.tn.gov.in).

name: Mukhya Mantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana
description: Comprehensive financial assistance program in Uttar Pradesh to prevent female foeticide, establish girl-child health rights, and encourage education through 6 phased milestones.
department: Department of Women and Child Development UP
beneficiary_type: Girl Children and School/College Students in UP
benefits: Total financial grant of Rs 25,000 phased across 6 milestones: birth (Rs 5,000), complete immunization (Rs 2,000), Class 1 admission (Rs 3,000), Class 6 admission (Rs 3,000), Class 9 admission (Rs 5,000), and Class 12 / 2-year diploma or degree admission (Rs 7,000).
eligibility_text: Resident of Uttar Pradesh. Annual family income must not exceed Rs 3,00,000. Maximum two girl children per family.
documents_required: Girl Child Birth Certificate, UP Domicile Certificate, Family Income Certificate, Aadhaar Card of Parents & Child, Bank Passbook, School Bonafide Certificate.
application_process: Apply online on the official Uttar Pradesh portal (mksy.up.gov.in) with required milestone documents.

name: Mukhyamantri Chiranjeevi Swasthya Bima Yojana
description: Universal cashless healthcare insurance scheme providing comprehensive hospitalization cover to families with special provisions for women and maternity care.
department: Medical, Health and Family Welfare Department Rajasthan
beneficiary_type: Families and Women Heads of Households in Rajasthan
benefits: Cashless medical insurance coverage up to Rs 25 Lakh per family per year across empaneled public and private hospitals, including critical illness and surgical packages.
eligibility_text: Residents of Rajasthan with Jan Aadhaar Card. Free for NFSA, SECC, small & marginal farmers, contract workers; other families can enroll at nominal Rs 850/year premium.
documents_required: Jan Aadhaar Card / Jan Aadhaar Enrolment Slip, Aadhaar Card, Ration Card.
application_process: Register online through SSO Rajasthan portal (chiranjeevi.rajasthan.gov.in) or via local E-Mitra center.

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana
description: Multi-stage financial incentive scheme in Bihar supporting girls from birth through graduation to curb infant mortality and encourage graduation.
department: Department of Social Welfare & Education Bihar
beneficiary_type: Girl Children and College Graduates in Bihar
benefits: Graduation incentive of Rs 50,000 for female graduates, Intermediate pass incentive of Rs 25,000 for unmarried girls, plus birth and school uniform assistance totaling over Rs 54,000.
eligibility_text: Permanent resident girl of Bihar. For graduation grant: graduated from a recognized Bihar university. For intermediate grant: unmarried female candidate.
documents_required: Degree/Intermediate Marksheet, Registration Card, Aadhaar Card, Resident Certificate of Bihar, Bank Passbook in student's name.
application_process: Submit application online via MedhaSoft portal (medhasoft.bih.nic.in) or E-Kalyan Bihar.

name: Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana
description: Direct cash transfer scheme in Madhya Pradesh to foster economic self-reliance, health, and nutrition among adult women.
department: Department of Women and Child Development MP
beneficiary_type: Adult Women in Madhya Pradesh
benefits: Direct monthly cash benefit of Rs 1,250 deposited on the 10th of every calendar month into Aadhaar-linked bank accounts.
eligibility_text: Resident women of Madhya Pradesh aged 21 to 60 years (married, widowed, divorced, or abandoned). Family annual income less than Rs 2,50,000. Non-taxpayer.
documents_required: Samagra Family ID & Member ID, Aadhaar Card linked to DBT bank account, Mobile number.
application_process: Register at local Gram Panchayat, Ward Office camps, or online portal (cmladlibehna.mp.gov.in).

name: Mukhyamantri Mahila Samman Yojana (Himachal Pradesh)
description: Direct monthly pension and financial support program in Himachal Pradesh recognizing the contribution of women in hill economies.
beneficiary_type: Women aged 18 years and above in Himachal Pradesh
benefits: Direct monthly financial allowance of Rs 1,500 transferred to beneficiary bank account.
eligibility_text: All women permanent residents of Himachal Pradesh aged 18 years and above, excluding government employees, pensioners, and income tax paying families.
documents_required: Himachal Bonafide Certificate, Aadhaar Card, Age Proof, Bank Passbook, Ration Card.
application_process: Submit prescribed application at Gram Panchayat or Tehsil Welfare Office.

name: Mukhyamantri Mahila Utkarsh Yojana (MMUY)
description: Interest-free loan scheme to empower women through Joint Liability Groups in rural and urban areas of Gujarat.
department: Women and Child Development Department Gujarat
beneficiary_type: Joint Liability and Earning Groups of Women (JLEG)
benefits: 0% interest loan of Rs 1 Lakh per group of 10 women (Rs 10,000 per member). Government pays entire interest directly to lending banks.
eligibility_text: Group of 10 women aged 18-59 years residing in Gujarat forming a Joint Liability Earning Group (JLEG).
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Residence Proof of Gujarat, Bank Passbook, Group Joint Undertaking.
application_process: Register group at Municipal Corporation / District Urban Development Agency or Gram Panchayat Taluka office.

name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
description: Maharashtra state social assistance program providing direct monthly financial support to economically disadvantaged women.
department: Department of Women and Child Development Maharashtra
beneficiary_type: Women in Maharashtra aged 21-65 years
benefits: Direct monthly cash transfer of Rs 1,500 transferred to the woman's Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
eligibility_text: Permanent resident woman of Maharashtra aged 21 to 65 years. Annual family income must not exceed Rs 2,50,000. Yellow or orange ration card holder.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Maharashtra Domicile / Ration Card, Income Certificate / Yellow/Orange Ration Card, Bank Passbook.
application_process: Apply online via the Nari Shakti Doot App or offline at Anganwadi centers, Setu Seva Kendras, and Gram Panchayats.

name: Orunodoi 2.0 Scheme
description: Assam's largest direct benefit transfer scheme targeting women as the financial custodians of vulnerable families for food, medicine, and nutritional security.
beneficiary_type: Female Nominated Heads of Poor Households in Assam
benefits: Monthly financial aid of Rs 1,250 deposited directly into the bank account of the woman nominated head of the family on the 10th of every month.
eligibility_text: Permanent resident of Assam. Family annual income less than Rs 2,00,000. Household must have a female beneficiary nominated. Preference to widows, unmarried women, and disabled members.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Ration Card / NFSA card, Assam Resident Certificate, Bank Passbook.
application_process: Applications verified via Gram Panchayat / Gaonburah and Urban Local Bodies; tracked on Orunodoi Assam portal.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
description: Special micro-credit facility providing affordable working capital collateral-free loans to urban street vendors and roadside sellers.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
beneficiary_type: Urban Street Vendors, Hawkers, Women Micro-Sellers
benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan of Rs 10,000 (1st tranche), Rs 20,000 (2nd tranche), and Rs 50,000 (3rd tranche). 7% interest subsidy on regular repayment.
eligibility_text: Street vendors engaged in vending in urban areas on or before March 24, 2020 holding Certificate of Vending or Urban Local Body recommendation letter.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Vending Certificate / Letter of Recommendation from ULB, Bank Account details.
application_process: Apply online at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or through local Common Service Centers (CSC) or municipal ward offices.

name: Post Graduate Indira Gandhi Scholarship for Single Girl Child
description: Financial scholarship to promote higher education among single girl children and offset the direct and indirect costs of university studies.
beneficiary_type: Single Girl Children pursuing Post-Graduation
benefits: Direct scholarship stipend of Rs 36,200 per annum (Rs 3,100 per month) for 2 years of regular master's degree program.
eligibility_text: Only girl child of family (or twin daughters) aged up to 30 years admitted into 1st year of full-time master's degree in a recognized Indian university/college.
documents_required: Affidavit on Rs 50 stamp paper certifying single girl child status, Aadhaar Card, Graduation Marksheet, College Admission Bonafide, Bank Passbook.
application_process: Register and submit scholarship form online through the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).

name: Post Graduate Indira Gandhi Scholarship for Single Girl Child
description: Scholarship of Rs 36,200 per annum for 2 years to support single girl child pursuing PG degree courses in non-professional streams.
ministry: University Grants Commission (UGC) / Ministry of Education
beneficiary_type: Women & Girls
benefits: Rs 3,100 per month (Rs 36,200 p.a.) for 2 years duration of PG course.
eligibility_text: Scholarship of Rs 36,200 per annum for 2 years to support single girl child pursuing PG degree courses in non-professional streams.
documents_required: Proof of Single Girl Child (Affidavit on stamp paper), Aadhaar Card, Graduation Marksheet, PG Admission Verification
application_process: Submit application via official portal: https://scholarships.gov.in/

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
description: Centrally sponsored conditional cash transfer scheme providing direct financial support to pregnant women and lactating mothers for health, nutrition, and partial wage compensation.
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
department: Department of Women and Child Development
beneficiary_type: Pregnant Women and Lactating Mothers
benefits: Direct cash benefit of Rs 5,000 in two installments for the first child, and Rs 6,000 in a single installment for a second child if the infant is a girl child.
eligibility_text: Pregnant and lactating women aged 19 to 45 years. Must belong to SC, ST, BPL, EWS, or hold MGNREGA card or disability certificate. Excludes regular government employees.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card of mother and husband, Mother and Child Protection (MCP) Card, Bank Account Details linked with Aadhaar, Income/BPL Certificate.
application_process: Register online via the PMMVY Citizen Portal (pmmvy.wcd.gov.in) or offline at nearest Anganwadi Center / approved health facility (ASHA worker).

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
description: Pregnant Women and Lactating Mothers (PW&LM) aged 19 years and above for first live child. Must belong to BPL, SC/ST, or hold MGNREGA job card.
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
department: Department of Women and Child Development
beneficiary_type: Pregnant women and lactating mothers
benefits: Financial benefit of Rs 5,000 in two installments directly into bank/post office account for first live child, and Rs 6,000 for second child if girl child.
eligibility_text: Pregnant Women and Lactating Mothers (PW&LM) aged 19 years and above for first live child. Must belong to BPL, SC/ST, or hold MGNREGA job card.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Bank Account Details, Mother and Child Protection (MCP) Card, Identity Proof, BPL Ration Card / Income Certificate
application_process: Apply online at https://pmmvy.wcd.gov.in/.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY 2.0)
description: Flagship social welfare program providing deposit-free LPG gas connections and targeted refills subsidy to women living in vulnerable households.
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
beneficiary_type: Women from Low-Income / BPL Households
benefits: Free LPG connection including cylinder deposit, regulator, safety hose, first LPG cylinder refill free, free double-burner gas stove, and Rs 300 subsidy per refill up to 12 refills/year.
eligibility_text: Adult woman aged 18+ belonging to poor households (SC/ST, PMAY, AAY, Forest dwellers, Most Backward Classes, or verified low-income self-declaration).
documents_required: Aadhaar Card of applicant and adult family members, Ration Card, Bank Account linked to Aadhaar, Proof of Address.
application_process: Submit application online via pmuy.gov.in or directly at any authorized LPG distributor (Indane, Bharatgas, HP Gas).

name: Stand Up India Scheme for Women Entrepreneurs
description: SC/ST and/or woman entrepreneur above 18 years of age. Enterprise must be greenfield (first time venture). In non-individual entities, 51% shareholding must be held by woman or SC/ST.
beneficiary_type: SC/ST and Women entrepreneurs
benefits: Bank loans between Rs 10 Lakh and Rs 1 Crore for setting up a greenfield enterprise in manufacturing, services, or trading sector.
eligibility_text: SC/ST and/or woman entrepreneur above 18 years of age. Enterprise must be greenfield (first time venture). In non-individual entities, 51% shareholding must be held by woman or SC/ST.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Project Profile, Bank Statements, Proof of Business Address, Category Certificate
application_process: Apply online at https://www.standupmitra.in/.

name: Stand-Up India Scheme for Women Entrepreneurs
description: Facilitates bank loans between Rs 10 Lakh and Rs 1 Crore to at least one SC/ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for greenfield enterprises.
beneficiary_type: SC/ST and Women Entrepreneurs
benefits: Composite loan covering term loan and working capital between Rs 10 Lakh and Rs 1 Crore, concession on margin money (up to 15%), and handholding support.
eligibility_text: SC/ST and/or woman entrepreneur aged 18 years and above. Must be a greenfield enterprise in manufacturing, services, agri-allied, or trading sector. In non-individual enterprises, 51% stake must be held by SC/ST or woman.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Project Report, Business Address Proof, Bank Statements, Category/Identity Proof.
application_process: Apply online at the Stand-Up Mitra portal (standupmitra.in) or directly visit any scheduled commercial bank branch.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
description: A government-backed small deposit savings scheme launched under the Beti Bachao Beti Padhao campaign to secure the future education and marriage expenses of girl children.
department: Department of Economic Affairs / Department of Posts
beneficiary_type: Girl Child (up to 10 years of age)
benefits: Guaranteed high interest rate (8.2% p.a.), triple tax exemption (EEE under Section 80C), 50% withdrawal allowed for higher education at age 18, and full maturity after 21 years.
eligibility_text: Resident Indian girl child aged below 10 years at account opening. Opened by parent/legal guardian. Maximum 2 girl accounts per family (triplets/twins exception).
documents_required: Birth Certificate of the girl child, Aadhaar Card / ID and Address Proof of the parent or guardian, Passport photographs.
application_process: Open account offline at any designated Post Office branch or authorized commercial bank branch with required identity and birth proof.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
description: Girl child who is an Indian resident aged below 10 years. Account opened by parents or legal guardians. Maximum 2 accounts per family.
beneficiary_type: Girl child below 10 years of age
benefits: High tax-free interest rate (currently 8.2% p.a.), tax savings under Section 80C, partial withdrawal for higher education at age 18, maturity at 21 years.
eligibility_text: Girl child who is an Indian resident aged below 10 years. Account opened by parents or legal guardians. Maximum 2 accounts per family.
documents_required: Birth Certificate of Girl Child, Identity & Address Proof of Guardian, Passport size photos
application_process: Apply online at https://www.indiapost.gov.in/Financial/Pages/Content/Sukanya-Samriddhi-Account.aspx.

name: Support to Training and Employment Programme for Women (STEP)
description: Scheme providing employability and vocational skills training to marginalized women to enable sustainable self-employment and micro-entrepreneurship.
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
beneficiary_type: Women and Artisans
benefits: Free modular training across traditional and modern skill sectors (handlooms, agro-processing, IT, healthcare, stitching), stipend during training, and placement support.
eligibility_text: Women aged 16 years and above, with priority for rural, urban poor, SC/ST, widows, and distressed female breadwinners.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Age proof, Residential Certificate, Income Certificate.
application_process: Apply through registered NGOs, State Women Development Corporations, or district skill development training centers.

name: Support to Training and Employment Programme for Women (STEP)
description: Women aged 16 years and above looking for skill development and employment, prioritizing marginalized, SC/ST, and rural women.
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
beneficiary_type: Women aged 16 years and above
benefits: Free skill training in traditional sectors (agriculture, horticulture, handlooms, handicrafts, tailors, IT) and support for wage employment/self-employment.
eligibility_text: Women aged 16 years and above looking for skill development and employment, prioritizing marginalized, SC/ST, and rural women.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Age Proof, Educational Certificate (if any), Caste Certificate
application_process: Apply online at https://wcd.gov.in/schemes/support-training-and-employment-programme-women-step.

name: Working Women Hostel Scheme (Sakhi Niwas)
description: Promotes availability of safe and affordable accommodation with daycare and crèche facilities for women in employment away from home.
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
beneficiary_type: Working Women, Trainees, and Job Seekers
benefits: Safe, furnished lodging at subsidized rentals, daycare center for children up to 8 years, 24x7 security, dining, and recreation facilities.
eligibility_text: Working women whose gross monthly salary does not exceed Rs 50,000 in metro cities or Rs 35,000 in other areas. Single women, widows, divorcees given preference.
documents_required: Proof of employment / appointment letter, Salary Slip, Aadhaar Card, Passport photos, Employer recommendation.
application_process: Apply directly through the local State Women Development Corporation or the hostel management committee portal.

name: Working Women Hostel Scheme (Sakhi Niwas)
description: Safe, affordable hostel accommodation with day care facilities for children of working women in urban, semi-urban, and rural areas.
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
beneficiary_type: Women & Girls
benefits: Subsidized secure lodging, daycare center (Crèche) for children up to 8 years, mess facilities, and 24/7 security.
eligibility_text: Safe, affordable hostel accommodation with day care facilities for children of working women in urban, semi-urban, and rural areas.
documents_required: Employment Certificate / Salary Slip, Aadhaar Card, Passport photo, Identity Card from Employer
application_process: Submit application via official portal: https://wcd.nic.in/schemes/working-women-hostel

name: YSR Cheyutha Scheme
description: Financial empowerment scheme in Andhra Pradesh providing multi-year cash assistance to middle-aged marginalized women for establishing sustainable micro-businesses.
beneficiary_type: SC, ST, BC, and Minority Women aged 45-60 years
benefits: Total financial assistance of Rs 75,000 distributed over four years (Rs 18,750 per annum) with technical enterprise support (Amul, ITC, P&G partnerships).
eligibility_text: SC, ST, BC, and Minority women aged between 45 and 60 years. Resident of Andhra Pradesh in low-income category.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Caste Certificate, Integrated Income Proof, Age Proof, Bank Passbook.
application_process: Apply at local Village/Ward Secretariat (Grama/Ward Sachivalayam) or through Navasakam portal.
